title: PR #69: fix(l1): preserve validator snapshots and correct E2E vote lifecycle
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

Follow-up to PR #68.

Root-cause fixes only:
- finalize_validator_snapshot() no longer appends a lower snapshot after recovery; durable pending activations are preserved.
- multi-process E2E no longer submits the same validator vote twice after produce_reward_block()/block import already vote automatically.
- L1 transaction lifecycle E2E migrates TRANSFER_AMOUNT from u64 to canonical u128.

No consensus duplicate-voter weakening, no snapshot regression bypass, no determinism allowlist, and no gate changes. Existing broad rustfmt failures in unrelated/pre-existing files are intentionally not mixed into this functional fix.
